description: This file contains shell script code that sets up and tests a git hooks workflow, including invoking other tools and verifying output.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook for testing, executing a command within a hook context.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs a provided shell script.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs an external tool, in this case 'proc-receive', with verbose output.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to make it more readable and consistent.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.
